DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 職場へ出す証明書のご相談ですね。お名前の変更があったと伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to discuss a certificate for work. I understand your name changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先月姓が変わりましたが、職場の書類はまだ前の姓のままです。住民票を出すよう言われて、名前が違ってもいいのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先月姓が変わったが職場は旧姓のままで、住民票との違いが心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, my surname changed last month, but work documents still use the old one. They asked for a resident record, and I worry about the different names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your surname changed last month but work still uses the old one, and you worry about the resident record difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 役所で現在のお名前を確認して発行することになります。職場の書類に合わせて、こちらで前の姓へ変えて発行することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The office will confirm your current name and issue it. We cannot change it back to the old surname to match your work documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現在の姓で発行されるんですね。職場へ出す時は、同じ人だと説明するために何が必要か、先に聞いた方がいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の姓で発行されると理解し、同一人の確認に必要なものを職場へ聞くか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it will be issued with my current surname. Should I first ask work what they need to establish that I am the same person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand it uses your current surname and ask about checking work's identity-linking requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。職場でどのような確認をするかは、担当の方に聞いてください。こちらでは必要だと断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, ask your work contact how they confirm that. We cannot declare here what will be necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人事へ姓の違いを伝えます。案内には本人の住民票で、特別な項目は不要とあります。今日は現在の姓で本人の分をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内が本人分で特別な項目は不要と説明し、現在の姓で本人分を発行できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell HR about the surname difference. The instructions say my own resident record without special fields. Could I request my own copy under my current surname today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the instructions require only your own record without special fields, and ask for issuance under your current surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、ご本人分の申請を進めましょう。申請書の名前も現在のお名前で記入してください。職場での旧姓とは分けて考えてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, let us proceed with your own application. Write your current name on the application too. Treat the old surname at work separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申請書は現在の姓で書きます。証明書を受け取った時も、姓が古いままになっていないか、その場で見てよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の姓で申請書を書き、受け取り時に証明書の姓をその場で確認してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write my current surname. When receiving the certificate, may I check on the spot that the surname is not still old?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will apply with your current surname and ask to check the certificate's surname immediately upon receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。お渡しする時にお名前や住所をご確認ください。気になる点があれば、その場でおっしゃってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Check your name and address when we hand it over. Tell us then if anything concerns you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現在の姓で申請して、受け取り時に名前と住所を確認します。職場には、旧姓のままの社内書類をどう直すか別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の姓で申請して名前と住所を確認し、旧姓の社内書類修正は職場へ別に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will apply with my current surname and check the name and address on receipt. Separately, I will ask work how to correct internal documents still using the old surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will apply under your current surname, check name and address, and separately consult work about correcting old-surname documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの確認先が整理できましたね。では、申請書を受付へお願いします。私は隣の窓口へ移ります。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have organized whom to ask for each check. Please take the application to reception. I will move to the next counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合へ行く前に、ふらついた時の様子を伺います。今も立っているのはつらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you go to the waiting area, let me ask about the unsteadiness. Is standing still difficult now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は座っていれば平気です。バスを降りて立った時にふらついたので、一人で歩くのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座れば平気だが降車後立った時にふらつき、一人で歩くのが不安と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am fine if seated now. I felt unsteady when standing after leaving the bus, so I am worried about walking alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say sitting is fine, but you became unsteady standing after leaving the bus and fear walking alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずこちらの椅子を使ってください。バスに乗っている間から気分が悪かったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use this chair first. Were you feeling ill while on the bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乗っている間は揺れが気になりましたが、気分は悪くありませんでした。降りてから、目の前が暗くなる感じがしたんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車中は気分不良なし、降車後に目の前が暗く感じたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The movement bothered me, but I did not feel ill while aboard. After getting off, I felt my vision going dark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you were not ill aboard, but your vision felt dark after getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗車中と降りた後では違うのですね。その時に転んだり、どこかを打ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So aboard and after getting off were different. Did you fall or hit anything then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 転んではいません。手すりにつかまりました。いつからというのは、バスに乗った時ではなく、降りた時刻を答えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転ばず手すりにつかまったと答え、発症時刻は降車時を示すか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not fall; I held the handrail. For when it started, should I give the time I got off rather than when I boarded?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you held the handrail without falling, and ask whether onset time means getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、今のお話ではふらつきが始まった時刻ですね。分かる範囲で教えてください。お薬の情報も診察で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, from your account, the time the unsteadiness began. Tell us as far as you know. Medication details will also be checked during examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 九時半頃です。薬の名前が分かる紙は家にありますが、家族に写真を送ってもらうことはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 九時半頃と伝え、薬の紙は家だが家族に写真を頼めると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Around nine thirty. The paper with medication names is at home, but I can have family send a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say around nine thirty, and that the medication paper is at home but family can send a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を送ってもらえたら、診察の時に見せてください。取りに帰るより、今はここで待ちましょう。待合へ移る時も声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If they send it, show it at your examination. Rather than go home for it, wait here now. Ask us when moving to the waiting area too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に写真を頼みます。椅子で待って、待合へ行く時は一人で立たずに看護師さんへ声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族に写真を頼み、座って待ち、移る時は一人で立たず看護師へ声を掛けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask family for the photo. I will wait seated and call a nurse instead of standing alone to move to the waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask family for a photo, wait seated and ask a nurse rather than stand alone when moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、移る時はお手伝いします。今の経緯は医師へ伝えますね。では、少し失礼します。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will help you move. I will tell the doctor what happened. Excuse me for a moment. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不審な電話についてのご相談ですね。今も相手と通話している状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to discuss a suspicious call. Are you still on the line with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話は切れています。銀行を名乗って口座を止めると言われ、留守番電話に折り返し先が残っていました。まだ掛け直していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行を名乗る口座停止の録音があり、通話は終わり折り返し未実施と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The call has ended. Someone claiming to be the bank said my account would be stopped and left a callback number in voicemail. I have not called back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a recording claims to be the bank stopping the account, the call ended and you have not called back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 折り返す前に確認しましょう。相手へ口座番号や暗証番号を伝えたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check before calling back. Have you given them your account number or PIN?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何も伝えていません。着信の表示と、録音で言っている折り返し番号が違うので、怪しいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 情報を渡しておらず、着信表示と録音の折り返し番号が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have given nothing. The displayed incoming number differs from the recording's callback number, so I thought it suspicious.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you gave no information and the incoming display differs from the recorded callback number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いも記録しておきましょう。着信履歴と録音は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Record that difference too. Do you still have the call history and recording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 両方残っています。録音を消さず、言っている番号を紙にも書きました。今、ここで聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 履歴と録音を残し番号もメモしたことを伝え、録音を聞いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both remain. I did not erase the recording and wrote the spoken number on paper too. Could you listen to it here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you kept the history and recording, wrote the number and ask them to listen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、確認します。銀行を名乗っているだけでは、本当にその銀行からか分かりません。銀行への確認は、別に確かめた連絡先を使いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I will check. Claiming to be the bank does not prove it is really from them. Use contact details checked separately when asking the bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 録音の番号へは掛けません。手元の銀行の書類に載っている番号を使おうと思いますが、その書類も一緒に確認していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録音の番号へは掛けず、手持ちの銀行書類の連絡先も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not call the recording's number. I plan to use the number on bank documents I have; could we check those documents together too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not call the recorded number and also want to check the contact on your bank document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちなら出してください。どの書類か伺います。こちらでは口座の状態は確認できないので、それは銀行へ直接尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take them out if you have them. I will ask which documents they are. We cannot check account status here; ask the bank directly about that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行から以前届いた書類がかばんにあります。履歴と録音は残して、書類を見ながら正規の窓口へ口座の状態を尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 以前届いた銀行書類を出し、記録を残したまま正規窓口へ口座状態を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have an earlier document from the bank in my bag. I will keep the history and recording and use the document to ask the official counter about account status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take out the bank's earlier document, keep the records and say you will ask the official contact about account status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず書類を確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。ここで少しお待ちください。いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us first check the document. Thank you for consulting us. Please wait here briefly; excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱を送られますか。中身とお届け先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this box? Tell me its contents and destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から借りた本が三冊入っています。友人の家へ返しますが、送料を受け取る側に払ってもらう方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた本三冊を友人宅へ返し、受取側が送料を払う方法があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are three books borrowed from a friend. I am returning them to my friend's house; is there a method where the receiver pays postage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are returning three borrowed books to a friend's house, and ask about recipient-paid postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人が送料を払う送り方はあります。ただ、ご友人にはその支払いを了承してもらっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a recipient-paid method. Has your friend agreed to pay that postage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、返す約束だけで送料までは話していません。急に支払いを頼むと困らせそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返す約束のみで送料負担は相談していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, we only agreed on returning them, not postage. Suddenly asking payment could inconvenience them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say only the return was agreed and postage costs were not discussed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人が払う前提で進めるより、今ここでご自身が負担するか、ご友人に先に相談するか決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than proceed assuming the receiver pays, decide whether to pay here yourself or discuss it with your friend first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 借りたお礼もあるので、今回は私が払います。本が入っていると、重さで送料が変わるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分が送料を払うと決め、本の重さで料金が変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since I am also grateful for the loan, I will pay this time. Does postage change with the weight of the books?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to pay postage yourself and ask whether book weight changes the price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この送り方では重さと大きさを確認します。箱は閉じた状態で量りますので、こちらへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this method we check weight and size. We weigh the closed box, so place it here please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱はもう閉じてあります。もし予定より高かったら、受け付ける前に送り方を相談し直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封済みの箱を渡し、想定より高ければ受付確定前に送り方を相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The box is already closed. If the cost is higher than expected, can I discuss another method before you accept it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over the sealed box and ask to reconsider the method before acceptance is finalized if it costs more than expected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、料金をご案内してからお決めいただけます。今の箱では、この送り方で千二百円です。まだ受付を確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can decide after we explain the price. This box costs twelve hundred yen by this method. Acceptance has not been finalized.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千二百円なら私が払います。友人には本を返送したことを伝えて、受け取りの際に送料を払う必要はないと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千二百円を自分が払い、返送と受取時の送料負担不要を友人へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: At twelve hundred yen, I will pay. I will tell my friend I sent the books back and that no postage payment is needed when receiving them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pay twelve hundred yen and tell your friend of the return and no postage charge on receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この送り方でお受けします。お控えもお持ちください。ありがとうございました。お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it using this method. Please take your record too. Thank you, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の内容をご確認中ですね。金額ではなく、日付について気になる点があるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are checking a transfer. Is your concern the date rather than the amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家賃を今日振り込みたいのに、画面には来週の火曜日と出ています。今日の操作をしたら、今日送られると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃を今日送りたいが画面は来週火曜で、操作日と送金日を同じだと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to send rent today, but the screen says next Tuesday. I thought operating today meant it would be sent today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want rent sent today but the screen shows next Tuesday, and you thought operation and transfer dates were the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は振込を指定する日です。今のまま進めると、来週火曜日の予約になります。まだ確定はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is the designated transfer date. Continuing as it is would book next Tuesday. It has not been confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確定前でよかったです。今日に直したいのですが、予約を一度作ってから取り消す必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確定前と理解し、今日へ直すため予約作成と取消しが必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Good that it is before confirmation. I want to change it to today; do I need to create the booking then cancel it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is unconfirmed and ask whether creating and cancelling a booking is needed to change to today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いいえ、この入力途中の画面で日付を選び直せます。予約を作る必要はありません。受取人と金額も改めて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: No, you can choose another date on this screen while entering information. You do not need to create a booking. Look again at recipient and amount too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付を今日に直しました。受取人は契約書の名前と同じで、金額は六万円です。手数料は、予定日を変えると変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日へ変更し、受取人は契約書と一致して六万円と確認し、日付変更による手数料差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I changed the date to today. The recipient matches the contract name, and the amount is sixty thousand yen. Does changing the planned date change the fee?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm today, recipient matching the contract and sixty thousand yen; ask about fee differences from changing the date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この振込では日付を変えても手数料は三百円です。六万円を送るため、合計で六万三百円が必要になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this transfer, the fee remains three hundred yen even if the date changes. Sending sixty thousand therefore needs sixty thousand three hundred in total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 合計六万三百円ですね。念のため、来週の予約が別に残っていないかも確認できますか。二回送るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合計六万三百円を理解し、来週予約が別に残っていないか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sixty thousand three hundred total. Could we also check that no separate booking for next week remains? I want to avoid sending twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand the total of sixty thousand three hundred and check for any separate booking next week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約一覧を開きましょう。今、来週火曜日の予約はありません。入力の途中だっただけです。今日の内容を確かめてから実行してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us open the booking list. No booking for next Tuesday exists now; you were only partway through entry. Check today's details before executing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約が残っていないと分かりました。今日、受取人、六万円、手数料三百円の四点をもう一度見てから実行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 重複予約がなく、日付、受取人、六万円、三百円を再確認して実行すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand no booking remains. I will check four points again before executing: today, recipient, sixty thousand yen and the three-hundred-yen fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say there is no duplicate booking and you will recheck date, recipient, sixty thousand and three hundred before executing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確認してから進めてください。操作で困ったらお呼びくださいね。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, check before proceeding. Call me if you need help operating it. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらで全部でしょうか。商品の合計は千二百七十五円です。袋はお付けしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this everything? The goods total twelve hundred seventy-five yen. Would you like a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は現金が千円だけなので、二百八十円のお菓子を戻したいです。袋も一枚必要ですが、代金は別に掛かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金千円だけなので二百八十円のお菓子を外したいと伝え、一枚の袋代を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have only a thousand yen in cash today, so I want to remove the two-hundred-eighty-yen snack. I also need one bag; does that cost separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you only have a thousand cash and want the two-hundred-eighty snack removed, then ask the price of one bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は一枚五円です。お菓子を外すと商品が九百九十五円、袋を合わせて千円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: A bag is five yen. Removing the snack makes goods nine hundred ninety-five, and a thousand including the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら千円に収まりますね。お菓子はどこへ戻せばいいですか。もう会計に通した後だと思うのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋込み千円と分かり、レジを通したお菓子をどこへ戻すか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then it stays within a thousand. Where should I put the snack back? I think it has already been scanned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the bag-inclusive thousand and ask where to return the scanned snack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ支払い前ですので、こちらで取り消して売り場へ戻します。お客様が持って戻らなくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Payment is not done yet, so we will cancel it and return it to the sales floor. You do not need to take it back yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。持っている千円札で払えばちょうどですね。ポイントで支払う操作はしなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取消しを頼み、千円札で払い、ポイント払いは使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. My thousand-yen note will be exact. No points-payment operation is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for cancellation, say you will pay a thousand-yen note and not use points payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現金千円でお受けします。ポイントをためるカードの提示も、今日はなしでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take a thousand in cash. Is it also fine not to present your points-earning card today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、カードを忘れました。今日は現金だけにします。外したお菓子が明細から消えたかも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード忘れのため現金だけにし、お菓子が明細から消えたか見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I forgot my card. Cash only today. I also want to see whether the removed snack is gone from the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you forgot the card, will use only cash and want to check the snack disappeared from the details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの明細で確認できます。お菓子はなく、商品九百九十五円と袋五円です。千円を確かに頂きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check these details. There is no snack: nine hundred ninety-five for goods and five for the bag. We have received a thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お菓子が外れていて、袋込みで千円と確認できました。商品を袋に入れて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: お菓子の取消しと袋込み千円を確認し、購入品を袋で持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I confirmed the snack was removed and the bag-inclusive total is a thousand. I will put the goods in the bag and take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm cancellation and a thousand including the bag, and say you will take the goods home in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。レシートをどうぞ。お気を付けて。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Here is the receipt. Take care, and please come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨が強くなってきましたね。園内をもう少し回られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The rain has become heavier. Will you walk around the park a little more?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 足が疲れているので、今日は散歩をやめたいです。濡れた道を長く歩かず、雨を避けて待てる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足が疲れたので散歩をやめ、長く濡れた道を歩かず雨を避けて待てる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My legs are tired, so I want to stop today's walk. Is there somewhere to wait out of the rain without a long walk on wet paths?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will stop due to tired legs and ask for sheltered waiting without a long walk on wet paths. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この先の休憩所に屋根があります。ここからは舗装された短い道で行けますが、雨で濡れていますので急がないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The rest area ahead has a roof. A short paved path leads there, but it is wet, so please do not hurry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 屋根のある休憩所へ行きます。家族に車で迎えを頼むなら、そこまで入ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 休憩所を選び、家族の車がそこまで入れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will go to the covered rest area. If I ask family for a car pickup, can they drive in that far?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the rest area and ask whether your family's car can enter that far. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一般の車は休憩所まで入れません。南口の外に乗り降りできる場所があります。車はそこへお願いしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ordinary cars cannot enter the rest area. There is a pickup place outside the south gate. Ask the car to come there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 南口の外ですね。家族には北口と送ってしまったので、先に訂正します。休憩所から南口へは坂がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 南口外と理解し、家族への北口の連絡を訂正して休憩所からの坂を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Outside the south gate. I already told family north gate, so I will correct it first. Is there a slope from the rest area to the south gate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand outside the south gate, correct your north-gate message and ask about slopes from the rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内図の青い道なら階段はありません。少し傾いた所がありますので、疲れている時は無理をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The blue route on this map has no stairs. Some parts slope slightly, so do not push yourself when tired.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩してから、青い道をゆっくり行きます。家族が着く前に南口で立って待つより、休憩所で到着の電話を待っていてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休んで青い道を行くと決め、先に南口で立たず休憩所で電話を待てるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will rest then take the blue path slowly. Rather than stand waiting at the south gate before family arrives, may I wait at the rest area for their call?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to rest and take the blue route, and ask to wait there for a call instead of standing at the south gate early. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、休憩所でお待ちいただけます。南口まで時間が掛かることを家族に伝えて、急いで向かわなくて済むよう相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can wait there. Tell family that reaching the south gate takes time, and discuss it so you do not need to hurry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩所で電話を待ち、到着後も急がず南口へ向かうと家族に伝えます。疲れが取れなければ、またこちらで相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩所で連絡を待ち、急がず南口へ行くと家族に伝え、疲労が残れば再相談すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell family I will wait for the call at the rest area and head to the south gate without rushing even after they arrive. If the tiredness remains, I will consult here again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain you will wait for contact at the rest area, tell family you will go slowly to the south gate, and consult again if still tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。足元に気を付けて休憩所へどうぞ。では、お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Watch your step going to the rest area. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅延の掲示と乗り場案内は別になっています。どちらの方向へ行くバスをご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The delay notice and boarding directions are separate. Which direction is your bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これから港へ行きます。『到着が遅れています』とあるので、港行きもまだ来ないのだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 港行きに乗りたいと伝え到着遅延掲示を見て自分の便もまだ来ないと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to the port. The sign says arrival delayed, so I thought the port-bound bus had not arrived either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want the port-bound bus and thought your service had not arrived because of the delayed-arrival notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その掲示は港からこちらへ戻る便についてです。港行きのこの便は、すでに一番乗り場で乗車を受け付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That notice is for the service returning here from the port. This port-bound service is already boarding at stop one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 方向が反対だったのですね。ここに書いてある便番号を、乗り場の番号と間違えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 掲示が反対方向と理解し便番号を乗り場番号と誤認していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was the opposite direction. I mistook the service number written here for the stop number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the notice is for the opposite direction and explain mistaking service number for stop number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 便番号は車両の運行を区別するもので、乗り場番号ではありません。お乗りになる港行きはこちらの案内の便です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The service number distinguishes vehicle operations, not stops. Your port-bound bus is the service on this information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、港行きは今乗れると分かりました。帰りに同じバスを使うつもりですが、帰りの時刻も変わるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今は港行きに乗れると確認し帰りに同じ路線を使う際の時刻も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I now understand I can board the port bus. I plan to take the same bus route back; will its return time also change?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you can board now and ask whether return times on the same route will change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の遅れが後の便へどこまで影響するかは、まだ分かりません。帰る前に、その時点の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We do not yet know how far the current delay will affect later services. Check the information current at the time before returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りまで遅れると決めつけない方がいいのですね。港で確認するとき、行きの便番号を言えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りの遅延を断定しないと理解し港で行きの便番号を伝えれば確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should not assume the return is delayed too. When checking at the port, should I give the outward service number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand the return delay is not definite, and ask whether the outward service number is enough when checking at the port. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰りに乗りたい時間帯と、この窓口へ戻る方向を伝えてください。行きの便番号だけでは、帰りの便を特定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: State the time period you want to return and the direction back here. The outward number alone cannot identify the return service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰りは港で、乗りたい時間帯とこちらへ戻る方向を伝えます。今は一番乗り場の港行きへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰りは希望時間帯と窓口へ戻る方向を伝え今は一番乗り場へ行くとまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: At the port I will state my desired return time period and direction here. For now I will go to stop one for the port bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize that you will give return time period and direction back, and go to stop one now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、乗り場へは正面の通路からどうぞ。足元に気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, use the passage ahead to the stop. Watch your step and have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会場の相談とのことですが、どんな集まりを計画されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to discuss a venue. What sort of gathering are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の人と交流会をしたいです。市の部屋を一つ予約して、読み聞かせと歌を一緒にできればと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地域交流会のため一部屋で読み聞かせと歌を行う会場予約を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a neighbourhood exchange gathering. I hope to book one city room for storytelling and singing together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult about booking one room for storytelling and singing at a community gathering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 歌では楽器やマイクも使いますか。利用内容によって、相談する施設が変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will singing involve instruments or microphones? The appropriate facility may depend on the activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さいスピーカーとマイクを使うつもりです。読み聞かせの後に歌うので、同時には音を出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小型スピーカーとマイクを使い読み聞かせ後に歌うので同時演奏ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: We plan a small speaker and microphone. Singing follows storytelling, so we will not produce sound simultaneously.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain a small speaker and microphone will be used, with singing after storytelling rather than simultaneous performance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 順番に行う場合も、音が出ることは施設へ伝えてください。今日は日付を決めたいのか、まず使える部屋を探したいのか、どちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even in sequence, tell the facility there will be sound. Today do you want to settle a date, or first find a usable room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず部屋を探したいです。希望の土曜日はありますが、まだ参加者に日時を約束していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まず部屋を探したく希望土曜はあるが参加者へ日時を約束していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: First find a room. There is a Saturday we prefer, but no date or time has been promised to participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say room search comes first, there is a preferred Saturday but no promised date or time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、活動内容を整理して施設担当へ相談しましょう。希望の日だけでなく人数も必要です。何人くらいを予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us organize activities and consult facility staff. We need numbers as well as the preferred date. About how many?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大人十人と子ども五人です。相談の予約を取る前に、担当へメールで活動内容を送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大人十人子ども五人と伝え相談予約の前にメールで活動内容を送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ten adults and five children. Can I email the activities before booking a consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say ten adults and five children and ask whether activities can be emailed before a consultation booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡方法は担当へ確認します。マイクの使用と十五人の参加予定、希望日が未確定ということを伝えて取り次ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check contact methods with the staff. I will pass on microphone use, fifteen planned participants and that the preferred date is not fixed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。部屋が決まるまでは参加者に確定日を知らせず、読み聞かせと歌、それに機材のことをまとめて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋決定までは確定日を知らせず活動順と機材を整理して担当へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not announce a firm date until the room is settled, and will organize storytelling, singing and equipment for consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not give a firm date until room confirmation, and will organize activity order and equipment for the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容を整理できましたね。施設担当へおつなぎしますので、こちらで連絡方法を確認しましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have organized the details. I will connect you to facility staff, so let us check contact methods here. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後の説明は聞けましたか。お帰りの前に、仕事のことで確認したいことがあるそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you able to hear the post-examination explanation? I understand you want to check something about work before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に受診したことを知らせたいのですが、病名まで書いた紙が必ず要るのか分かりません。領収書はもう受け取っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社へ受診を知らせる際に病名の紙が必須か不明で領収書は受領済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to tell work I attended, but do not know whether a paper with the illness name is essential. I have already received the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a diagnosis paper may or may not be necessary for notifying work of attendance, and you already have the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から何を確認したいと言われていますか。通院した事実の確認と、働き方についての医師の記載は別の内容です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What does work want to confirm? Proof of attendance and a doctor's statement about working arrangements are different matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話では『午前中に休んだ理由が分かるもの』と言われました。仕事内容を変えてもらう相談はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社は午前休暇の理由が分かる物を求め仕事内容変更の相談はしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the phone they asked for something showing why I took the morning off. I have not discussed changing my duties.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain work wants the reason for morning leave, and no change of duties has been discussed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず勤務先へ、受診日の分かる書類で足りるか確認してください。医師が書く書類の相談は受付でできます。領収書はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: First ask work whether a document showing the visit date suffices. Reception can discuss documents written by a doctor. Do you have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。診察内容も全部伝える紙だと思って、会社に見せるのが少し不安でした。領収書のどこを見れば受診日が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 領収書を診察内容全体の紙と思い提出が不安だったと伝え受診日欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I thought it was a paper revealing the entire examination, so I was a little anxious about showing work. Where on the receipt is the visit date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you worried about submission because you thought the receipt showed all examination details, and ask for the date field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類の見方は会計窓口で確認しましょう。私から、日付の確認と会社へ提出する書類の相談をしたいと伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us ask the payment counter how to read it. I can tell them you want to check the date and discuss papers for work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。会社が別の書類を求めた場合でも、今持っている領収書は保管しておけばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計への引継ぎを頼み会社が別書類を求めても元の領収書を保管すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Even if work requests a different document, should I keep my current receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for handover to payment staff, then ask whether to keep the original receipt even if work wants another document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、捨てずに保管してください。別の書類の内容や費用は受付で確認し、必要なものが分かってから申し込んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, keep it rather than discard it. Confirm other documents' content and fees with reception, then apply once you know what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書は残します。会社には通院した日の確認で足りるか聞いて、必要な書類が決まってから受付に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を保管し会社へ日付確認で足りるか聞いて必要書類決定後に受付へ相談するとまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the receipt. I will ask work whether checking the attendance date is enough, and consult reception after the necessary document is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-42210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize keeping the receipt, asking work whether date confirmation suffices and consulting reception once requirements are decided. Say it in Japanese.
